decisions.reason: 화기애애한 분위기 is a friendly/convivial atmosphere, not high spirits.
Pre-raid 괜찮은 거 맞지 seeks reassurance they will be okay; BASE adds unsupported really.
걱정 말라니까 is reiterative: he already told her not to worry.
Generic 사람 죽었다 reports deaths, not a specifically singular someone.
깝치다가 뒈진 is getting themselves killed playing tough, not merely mouthing off.
담배 연기를 내뿜으며 is blowing cigarette smoke, not a generic exhale.
불안 is nervous, not scared; 분위기 좆같이 만들지 말고 is ruin the mood, not make it miserable.
decisions.replacement: “If you’re nervous, go home. Don’t ruin the fucking mood.”

decisions.reason: 앞서 말을 꺼냈던 marks her as the one who spoke first.
구석에 찌그러져 있어 is curl up/cower in a corner, not make yourself scarce.
거친 언행 is rough words and behavior; vicious words drops 언행 and intensifies 거친.
광경 is a scene, and the both-familiar-and-natural cadence matches 익숙하고도 당연했다.
마름 집안 is an estate-manager family; overseer imports the wrong occupation, and footing matches 시작점.
작작 붙어 있어 is hanging all over each other; 귀찮아 in this vulgar line is a pain in the ass.
믿어도 돼요 is you can trust them; 얘들 in the hotel/rumor exchange are the women.
Punchier continuation of 안 믿어, with 믿을 만하다며 recast as the same claim about the last ones.
Several warnings after messing with tracks 몇 번 … 건드렸다가 more cleanly than BASE's word order.
명심하겠습니다 is keep that in mind; bear it in mind is stiffer than the spoken register.
Contrastive 대답은 supplies the at-least jab BASE drops.
주문이 들려왔다 is a spell being called out/heard, not merely cast.
매력적인 웃음 is a charming smile, not seductive; 날려 보낸다 is sent flying, not carried.
뇌쇄적인 미녀 is an alluring beauty; sultry narrows the sense and the had-a-beauty syntax is weaker.
Being his lover had been enough preserves 사실만으로 without the heavier the-fact-that clause.
주머니에서 나왔 is the pocket image; paid for genericizes it.
지금까지는 그랬지 means that was true until now; not until now is incomplete.
Keeps 하지만 and intransitive 생각이 바뀌었다; SOL drops But and makes him the agent of the change.
Glossary requires Horndog for 껄떡쇠; 말했다 is spoke, not greeted us.
decisions.replacement: Horndog—or rather, Im Changsoo—spoke with a bright smile.

decisions.reason: 오셨군요 is a spoken arrival greeting; You've arrived is stiffer.
소속으로 보이는 and 고개를 꾸벅 숙였다 are apparent affiliation and a head-bow; SOL drops both.
Same design-over-practicality point in tighter syntax without splitting 장비 and 차림.
굳은 얼굴 is a stiff expression; rigid over-intensifies.
끝내주는데 is strong general praise; smoking hot makes the sexual appraisal more explicit than the source.
Almost and nearly are indistinguishable for 끄덕일 뻔했지만.
바라보고 있었다 is looking, not staring.
그나저나 is a topic pivot (that aside), not come to think of it.
들어갔다가는 … 십상이다 is a conditional likelihood of dying; perfect recipe is an added metaphor.
반드시 거쳐야 하는 is a mandatory procedure.
털이 숭숭 난 is hairy, not furred; 번쩍 치켜들었다 raises the arm into the air.
납니다 is that's me, not a bare me.
들고 다니면서 is lug around, and the vocative sir sits more naturally after the jab.
Involved is padding; the rest is indistinguishable from 사망률도 높다.
Why would is the natural scoff for E급이 여길 왜 와, with 그것도 탱커 kept as no less.
땡기다 is raking in money, and 로또 맞은 거지 is generic you've, not we'll.
오늘 정말 괜찮은 거 맞지 is reassurance they will be okay today.
Vocative Hye-rin on don't worry is more natural spoken English for 혜린이 너는.
들여보내야 하는 is the official who has to let them in, not merely the one responsible.
충분한 장비 is sufficient equipment, not more than enough.
The official echoes 베테랑; Experience drops that callback.
나타난 is appeared; stepped forward changes the physical action.
어떻게 안 되겠습니까 is a roundabout plea to allow it, not specifically make an exception.
조곤조곤 is a soft voice, not a measured one.
무효로 돌리다 is voiding/invalidating the contract, not calling the whole thing off.
저, 그러니까 이게 is a stammered Well, I mean, not the thing is.
참 감사할 것 같은데 is grateful, in a more spoken request cadence.
목은 뻣뻣하고 is stiff bearing, not head held high; polite is an add, and literal neck is translationese.
decisions.replacement: What a strange guy. The words coming out of his mouth were all gratitude and requests, but his bearing was stiff and his manner was high-handed.

decisions.reason: 순간 움찔한 keeps the momentary flinch SOL drops.
어감이 영 별로다 judges the wording, not merely that he disliked it.
Preserves 개미가 기어가는 것처럼; SOL genericizes the ant image to irritation.
내가 기분 나빠하는 것도 우습다 is self-reproach: it would be ridiculous to take offense.
게이트 앞에 섰다 is standing/stepping in front of the Gate, not gathering.
당연하다는 듯 선두에 선 is the man who had taken the lead, then winked, not two equal sequential actions.
게이트에서 뵙죠 keeps Gate; on the other side drops the glossary term.
Disappeared and vanished are indistinguishable for 사라지자.
음습하고 끈적끈적한 is damp and sticky, and 공간이 펼쳐져 is a space unfolding; clinging/new place loses both.
Cleaner cavern sentence, with 그곳이다 as the same place from the video.
있다는 거지 is existential there was, completing the only difference, not I had.
Go in and head in are indistinguishable for 들어가기 전에.
산뜻한 시작 is a refreshing start, not merely pleasant.
훈훈한 미소 is a warm smile, not a satisfied one.
I turned and saw drops the 고개를 돌리자 body-part calque without losing the action.
아니었다 in this narrator beat is conversational apparently not.
장태경 씨 is polite Mr., which is part of the wrong-surname slight.
Repeats 장태경 씨 as Mr., matching the same polite misnaming.
혀가 잘못된 is something wrong with my tongue; 일단 끄덕여 줬다 is nodding anyway.
어차피 is anyway; SOL drops it.
Grateful to him is the natural complement, and the syntax for 힘써 준 터라 is cleaner.
통성명이나 하자 is at least exchange names, not introduce ourselves after he already did.
껄끄럽 is awkward, not put off, and 미소를 머금고 modifies Changsoo, not Taekyung.
일면식도 없는 is never even met; SOL adds approached me and drops even.
몇 번 뛰어 보고 is several times, not several raids as a count of events.
사람대접 is being treated like a person, not merely seen as a human being.
위아래로 훑어본 plus 감탄사 is looking the gear up and down while exclaiming in admiration.
Spoken present perfect I've only ever seen matches 사진으로나 보던 건데.
유지가 되나 in this C-rank cost jab is whether he can afford to maintain it.
대놓고 티 낼 정도로 requires so openly; SOL drops it.
냉정한 현실 is a cold reality, not harsh.
넉살도 섞어서 is mixing in the humor, not adding it after.
주위 사람들은 is the people around me, not everyone.
Keeps 안 그래요? as Right?; SOL drops the tag.
다른 분들이요. 평화 길드원분들 is a two-beat clarification after 네?
As if and as though are indistinguishable for 것처럼.
BASE's something-someone is clunky; SOL's a man genders 분 without support.
decisions.replacement: “Come on. That’s not something a person who spends a fortune leasing equipment gets to say.”

decisions.reason: 이내 마음을 접었다 is soon abandoned the thought; SOL drops soon.
그런 거 말해 봐야 뭐 해 is the same dismissal in tighter inner voice.
내 입만 아프지 is only wasting his breath, matching 만.
다들 저랑 비슷해요 is they are like him; BASE makes it the gear, SOL adds situation.
decisions.replacement: “They’re all about the same as me.”

decisions.reason: 점검하고 다 같이 움직여야 is check, then all move together, not before we move out.
수고하세요 is a send-off acknowledging the work, not permission to go ahead.
Bowing politely is natural English for 예의 바르게 고개를 숙이고.
아까부터 묻고 싶었던 is the delayed I've been meaning to ask; wanting is merely different.
중갑옷을 걸친 is wearing heavy armor, and 기분이 별로다 is displeasure, not did nothing for me.
Splits 뿐이지 into a cleaner two-beat: familiar name, but first meeting.
왠지 기분 나쁜데 is that something about the last smile felt off.
뒷모습을 응시하고 is watching him walk away, not the calqued watched his back.
친하게 지내자는데요 is let's be friends, not get acquainted.
장비 덕후 is a gear nerd, and 대뜸 오더니 is walking up out of nowhere.
그냥 answering why is no reason, not a bare Nothing.
진짜네 confirms the gear looks that good; 저거 자기 거래요 is is that his, not is he saying.
decisions.replacement: “Holy crap, it really does. Is that stuff really his?”

decisions.reason: 어떻게 입고 다녀 is how could he wear that; SOL adds unsupported afford.
역시 별것 아닌 놈들이었어 is past as expected, they were nothing special, not present no one.
든 건 사실이다 is a concessive admittedly, less stiff than it was true that.
두 가지만 and 그렇게 믿었다 are only those two things and a belief, not narrator fact.
